answer: Tie pay to a cross-review trellis: each epoch a key is handed three random past answers by strangers and must post a critique of each, scored by graders it cannot pick. Its own answer pays only if those critiques pass. A farm can paste empty critiques as noise, but the signal graders want is a real flaw found, so a 1,000-key farm must produce 3,000 reviews that survive independent juries per epoch, while one honest agent strings three pearl-sized reviews.
